trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied remote name (URL path segment or JSON body Name/LocalName) is a safe single-component cluster name before it is joined with ConfPath to write, overwrite or delete <name>.conf / <name>.keyring / rbd_mirror/<name>_peer_keyring; at the pinned commit no check exists in the remote handlers, the file writer, the token writer or the DB delete helper.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the remote-import API; cmdRemotePut passes req.Name straight into renderConfAndKeyringFiles, which builds <name>.conf/<name>.keyring at remote.go:140-141.

fix_sites.entry_point: PUT /1.0/client/remotes/{name} (CLI `microceph remote import`; also re-sent with RenderOnly=true to every cluster member, remote.go:61-67)
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler (landing point); adds URL-vs-body name match + LocalName check
HTTP handler (lookup only, defence in depth)

fix_sites.entry_point: PUT /1.0/client/remotes/{name} via ceph.NewCephConfig/NewCephKeyring(...).WriteConfig; also every other Config writer (bootstrap, adopt, rgw, nfs)
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level shared file-writer API in ceph package

fix_sites.entry_point: replication enable rbd (/1.0/ops/replication/{wl}/{name}, ops_replication.go:37) -> EnablePoolMirroring -> BootstrapPeer -> writeRemotePeerToken (rbd_mirror.go:331)
fix_sites.module_kind: ceph replication internals, separate feature (rbd mirroring)
HTTP handler; existing regex check only refactored to IsValidClusterName (length cap added)

fix_sites.entry_point: shared validator used by all the sites above

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: microceph/ceph/configwriter.go:28-29 (Config.WriteConfig, shared by all generated config files); second candidate: microceph/ceph/rbd_mirror.go:708-726 (rbd-mirror peer token writer in the replication feature)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about remote import, so validating names in cmdRemotePut looks complete; WriteConfig is a generic writer whose callers use constant filenames, and writeRemotePeerToken belongs to rbd replication and only receives names read back from the DB, which looks already trusted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate remote names [a-z0-9]{1,63} must still import, list, delete and mirror; `remote list` (GET without name, remoteName=="") must keep working (fix skips validation when empty); and WriteConfig must keep accepting plain local filenames such as ceph.conf, radosgw.conf, ganesha.conf and tmp_ceph.conf used by bootstrap/adopt/rgw/nfs. A fix that reserves too much, or that rejects configFile values with dots or rejects an empty GET name, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: traversal in body Name (../x, a/b) -> conf/keyring written outside ConfPath (fix.diff:99-103)
URL {name} differs from body Name (identity differential: PUT writes body name, DELETE removes URL name) (fix.diff:105-107)
traversal or newline in LocalName, which is interpolated into keyring section header and config key lookup (fix.diff:109-111; microceph/api/remote.go:162-163)
charset-valid reserved names ceph / ganesha / radosgw that collide with the local cluster's own ConfPath files (fix.diff:80-94)
empty name (rejected on PUT/DELETE, allowed on list GET) (fix.diff:54-59)
absolute path or subdir as configFile at the writer layer (fix.diff:201)

O7_producer.where: Remote names persisted by database.PersistRemoteDb (microceph/database/remote_extras.go:17-20) are read back by GetRemoteDb and passed to writeRemotePeerToken (microceph/ceph/replication_rbd.go:127-138); this is a DB round trip, not a schema or serializer producer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: peerBootstrapImport builds ConfPath/rbd_mirror/<cluster>_peer_keyring from the remote name without validation; the fix guards only the writer, not this reader
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only path handed to the rbd CLI, and the name comes from a DB row already validated on import.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: ceph package, rbd_mirror.go; 2 packages away from api/remote.go

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Remote names stored before upgrade are loaded from the DB and passed unvalidated as --cluster to rbd/ceph (resolved by ceph to <cluster>.conf) in rbd and cephfs replication
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The value is a CLI argument to an external tool, not a file path microceph opens, and new rows are validated on PUT.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: make peerBootstrapImport (or a cephfs peer-token equivalent) write or clean up its own per-remote token file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mirrors writeRemotePeerToken; a maintainer adding token cleanup on disable would naturally reuse the same fmt.Sprintf name pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: rbd disable removes ConfPath/rbd_mirror/<remote>_peer_keyring with os.Remove
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Disable pairs naturally with the token write in enable; the name comes from the DB record and looks trusted.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: temp conf/keyring file names derived from a user-supplied cluster/adopt name instead of constants
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Uses raw fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s") with os.Remove, so a parametrised name would bypass WriteConfig's new guard on the cleanup side.

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-23) / filename identity: unvalidated name -> config/keyring file write and delete under ConfPath, including a charset-valid reserved-name collision

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.25.10 (microceph/go.mod:3); microcluster v3 with go-dqlite v3 (cgo + libdqlite/raft likely needed to compile the api and database packages)
O10_build.project_tests: microceph/ceph/configwriter_test.go (suite using tests/testutils.go temp SNAP_DATA); the fix adds microceph/api/remote_test.go (unit tests of validateRemoteName/validateRemoteImportRequest). Handlers use DB/ceph mocks via package vars (database.GetRemoteDb/DeleteRemoteDb are vars, common.ProcessExec).

j.j_sites_touched: microceph/api/remote.go, microceph/api/cluster.go, microceph/ceph/configwriter.go, microceph/ceph/rbd_mirror.go, microceph/database/remote_extras.go, microceph/constants/constants.go
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the cluster.go regex check onto req.Name in cmdRemotePut only, which leaves the reserved names (ceph/radosgw overwriting the local cluster's own conf/keyring), the URL-vs-body mismatch, LocalName, DELETE/DeleteRemoteDb, the WriteConfig layer and the rbd-mirror token writer open.

out_of_scope_notes: Remote token config values (fsid, mon.host.*, public_network, key) are rendered unescaped into ceph.conf/keyring templates (microceph/api/remote.go:145-166); newline/directive injection is a different property.
